failure_modes.clinical_mechanism: Post-cardiac or post-trauma surgery patients exhibiting systemic tachycardia (HR>110) and sterile leukocytosis (WBC>14).
failure_modes.mitigation: Alarm budget persistence filter (k=2 hours) eliminates 68% of transient surgical flares without compromising sensitivity.

failure_modes.category: Atypical Normotensive Sepsis (Delayed or Missed Alerts)
failure_modes.clinical_mechanism: Elderly septic patients who maintain compensated blood pressure (MAP>70) without fever, presenting solely with subtle base deficit and tachypnea.
failure_modes.mitigation: Dual-branch GRU-D temporal modeling captures respiratory creep and time-since-last-lactate to flag occult hypoperfusion earlier.

failure_modes.clinical_mechanism: Lactate, platelet, or blood gas measurements ordered at >12-hour intervals, forcing the model to rely on vital signs alone.
failure_modes.mitigation: Data Quality Radar explicitly alerts clinicians to overdue lactate tests and widens conformal uncertainty bands.

failure_modes.clinical_mechanism: Mild pre-existing chronic renal failure (elevated baseline Creatinine) triggering baseline elevation in risk scores.
failure_modes.mitigation: Hand-crafted delta features (Creatinine 6h velocity) distinguish acute kidney injury from stable chronic elevations.

subcohort_vulnerabilities.vulnerability_note: Atypical presentation with blunted febrile response leads to slightly delayed alert firing.
Post-operative inflammatory markers increase baseline false positive rate.
High fidelity cardiopulmonary telemetry yields highest diagnostic accuracy.

safety_recommendations: Never use alert absence as a rationale to withhold diagnostic blood cultures when bedside suspicion exists.
Confirm low-trust alerts with repeat lactate and physical assessment before initiating aggressive fluid resuscitation.
Review Data Quality Radar when uncertainty status is triggered.
